full_judgment: 13. At one stage a portion of the said leased property was forcibly occupied by some bad elements of the locality and the BADC as a legal owner of the said property ousted those bad elements from the land through police force. Accordingly the BADC has been enjoying the leased property peacefully, without interference from any corner. Afterwards, while the BADC was in possession of the leased property being 0.71 acres out of the scheduled property of the plaint as aforesaid, the plaintiffs filed the present suit being TS No.290 of 1984 in the 1st Court of the Munsif at Dhaka praying for derequisition and khas possession of the scheduled land property including the said 0.71 acres of leased property rightfully owned and possessed by the BADC. The Chairman of the BADC has been impleaded in the suit as defendant No.3 but the Bangladesh Agricultural Development Corporation itself and other concerned officers including the Secretary of the Corporation who has entered into the aforesaid 99 years lease agreement with the government have not been impleaded as defendants in the instant suit.
